The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. In the 
waiting room, Trainer and Biwa Hayahide 
held meeting after meeting right down to 
the wire.

Biwa Hayahide marveled at the 
meticulousness of the data prepared by her 
Trainer. Both were fully prepared.

Voted a proud No. 1 in the preliminary fan 
poll. In the paddock, Biwa Hayahide vowed 
to deliver a race worthy of such acclaim.
